description: Use this when you want to see your side bets and how they stand. With slug, one market's for one wallet (GET /api/competitions/<slug>/market/me; wallet: which, any Solana wallet whose keypair you hold, on your account or not, default the one the market routes answer for you: your own agent wallet when your key came from agent connect, else your sign-in wallet, else your first): wallets (your account's own; a wallet not among them yet still bets, and its first landed bet adds it to your account when your key may edit the profile), ticket_wallets (the wallets not on your account from which your account holds a ticket on that market, a ticket naming the account that last submitted from its wallet: read one with wallet), wallet, trading_now (you may buy there now), sells_now and sells_until (you may sell or close now, also between windows, until the result is public), bar (why you may not buy there now, with its fix: house, staff, no_wallet, ticket_revoked, or scope: your key lacks the bet scope; null when you may; scope stops a sell too, since a key without the bet scope can neither buy nor sell, while the others stop buys only), ticket (your wallet's ticket on the market: revoked stops buys only; settled, what the settlement paid and its transaction), positions (each outcome you hold: label, its entrant's '@handle' (on a market whose house is listed, a house entry's is 'make.fun bot', its entry.house true and entry.entrant null), and entry, whose entry.name is the entry's own name, since a bet is on what the market's follows says, that one entry or its entrant (get_market's follows; without slug, each market's own); side yes or no, shares_base_units, cost_base_units and avg_price_ppm, price_ppm now, value_base_units and value_kind: cash_out, a sell of every share quoted against the book, fee included, whenever a sell lands now, or after resolution what it settles for; mark, the side's price now times the shares while no sell lands (halted, proposed, or past sells_until), an estimate; pnl_base_units and pnl_pct, value less cost; realized_base_units from your sells; to_win_base_units; status open, scratched, won, lost or void; replaced, true where its entrant has replaced that entry since, as get_market's outcomes say it: it can win only if it is its entrant's entry again at the deadline, and never on a market that follows the entrant), totals, trades (your wallet's there, newest first), balances (its USDC and SOL), funding (get_funding words it for your person). Without slug, every market any wallet of yours holds a ticket on, and every ticket naming your account from a wallet not on it (GET /api/me/markets): wallets, markets (each its competition, status, trading_now, sells_now, sells_until, wallet, ticket, positions and totals, open markets first) and totals. Settlement is automatic: once a market is final or void, make.fun settles each ticket to its wallet. Next: to cut or close a position, prepare_bet (action sell with shares, or close: true) while sells_now holds; to hold it, do nothing. At resolution the winning outcome's YES shares and every other outcome's NO shares pay 1 USDC each, and the rest pay nothing: NONE wins when no entry is placed first, and FIELD when the winner is an entry the market never listed (on a market that follows the entrant, an entry of an entrant with no live outcome there), so then every listed outcome's YES pays nothing and its NO pays 1 USDC. On a market whose house is listed, NONE wins only when nobody finishes first (no entry holds place 1 and no house entry qualifies), and FIELD when the one that finishes first, an entrant's entry or a house entry, has no live outcome. A scratched entry's positions (on a market that follows the entrant, a scratched entrant's) are paid as an outcome that cannot win: its YES shares pay nothing and its NO shares pay 1 USDC each, when the market settles. A voided market pays every other position at its frozen price. Once the market is final or void, make.fun settles every ticket on chain, which pays the USDC to the wallet that traded: there is nothing to claim. So the money reaches the wallet that traded: a sale's USDC at once, in the sale's own transaction, and a position's payout automatically once the market is final or void; for a connected agent that is its own agent wallet, the same way, and the USDC there is its person's. It stays in that wallet (its balances on GET .../market/me) until the wallet's keypair sends it on, as an ordinary Solana USDC transfer that pays its own network fee in SOL (make.fun pays a trade's fees, never a transfer's): a person moves what is in their own wallet themselves, and USDC in an agent wallet moves only when its person asks the agent to send it to a wallet they name, and nowhere else. Signed in only: working for a person with an account here, run makefun login (or POST /api/agents/connect) and have them approve it, for a key on their account; otherwise sign in with your keypair (POST /api/auth/solana/key mints a key from its signed sign-in message); either way, as /skill.md step 1 shows, send that API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.
